_comment: Strings the design owns, each with the file that must contain it verbatim.
Every entry was read out of UI/Send to eReader - App.dc.html by hand and
carries the line it came from. The port drifted from roughly 120 of these
before anything noticed, because nothing in the suite could tell a reworded
label from a correct one. This file is what tells them apart.
Adding an entry means the design says it. Changing one means the design
changed, or the change is a deliberate override -- and a deliberate override
belongs in OVERRIDES in copy.test.ts with the reason, not here.
